data.contentEn:
‍

Investigation and sanctions for violations of the safe transaction policy

‍

‍‍

1. A: All products will be suspended from sale for 30 days.

‍

1-1. ASI 2-WAY Puffer Heavy Duck Down Jacket

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days starting January 7, 2025.

‍

1-2. (VLADIMIR) Reversible Down Jacket

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio (testing was conducted with products obtained by our company)

- Violation: Violation of the safe transaction policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded, 80 cumulative penalty points awarded for 2 violations of the safe transaction policy

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 30 days from January 12, 2025. All purchasers will be notified of a recall and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

‍

2. B: All products will be sold for 5 days.

‍

2-1. Light crop duck down

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions:All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days from January 13, 2025. All purchasers will be notified of a product recall and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

‍

‍

data.contentZh:
‍

对违反安全交易政策的行为进行调查和制裁

‍

‍‍

1. A：所有产品将暂停销售30天。

‍

1-1. ASI 双向羽绒服（重磅鸭绒）

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策 1 次，扣除 40 分

- 制裁措施：自 2025 年 1 月 7 日起暂停销售所有产品 5 天。

‍

1-2.（弗拉基米尔）双面羽绒服

- 违规事项：错误报告降水混合比例（测试使用的是我公司获得的产品）

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告违反安全交易政策，被扣除 40 分；因两次违反安全交易政策，累计扣除 80 分。

- 制裁措施：自 2025 年 1 月 12 日起暂停销售所有产品 30 天。所有购买者将收到召回通知，并将办理退款（个别联系）。

‍

‍

2. B：所有产品将销售 5 天。

‍

2-1. 轻度刈割鸭绒

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策1次，扣除40分。

制裁：自 2025 年 1 月 13 日起，所有产品将暂停销售 5 天。所有购买者都将收到产品召回通知，并将办理退款（个别联系）。
